request.text: Cancel the weather check for a safe hour to spray the roses—don't give me the forecast now. Leave the 6 p.m. reminder to bring the tortoise inside alone.

responsibilities.outcome: Cancel only the rose-spraying weather check without returning forecast information or changing the tortoise reminder.

new_goals.description: Cancel the weather check for a safe rose-spraying hour without providing a forecast or changing the tortoise reminder.
new_goals.source_text: Cancel the weather check for a safe hour to spray the roses—don't give me the forecast now. Leave the 6 p.m. reminder to bring the tortoise inside alone.
constraints: Do not alter the 6 p.m. tortoise reminder.
success_criteria: Only the rose-spraying weather-check goal is canceled.

semantic_facts: The response should factually acknowledge cancellation of the rose-spraying weather-check goal using the trusted evidence.
It should not perform or summarize the canceled weather lookup, even if forecast information might still be useful.
The 6 p.m. tortoise reminder is sibling work and must not be canceled, completed, recreated, or otherwise changed.
forbidden_claims: The assistant provides current weather, predicts a safe spraying hour, or claims the forecast lookup completed.
The assistant claims it canceled, completed, recreated, or rescheduled the tortoise reminder.
The assistant equates cancellation of the information request with spraying the roses or deciding that spraying is safe.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A canceled information goal is nevertheless executed because its answer appears practically useful.
A sibling reminder is recreated or modified under the guise of preserving it.
The planner conflates cancellation of research with completion of the downstream garden decision or chore.
